claim_or_decision: Kaggle public datasets provide zero training-eligible sources for PT1 (guaranteed_cash_annual) in India
contradictory_evidence: Many Kaggle uploaders label scraped CSVs as CC0 Public Domain or open
practical_implication: ArthaIQ must not use Kaggle salary CSVs as ground-truth training labels; prevents legal liability and target contamination
validation_experiment_required: T1.06 PLFS official benchmark audit and T2.10 voluntary contribution program

claim_or_decision: Stack Overflow Developer Survey is valid as an exploratory benchmark for tech stack coefficients and YOE curves
contradictory_evidence: Self-reported total comp bundles bonuses/informal pay; sample overrepresents enthusiastic open-source developers
practical_implication: Use SO data under separate target branch (comp_total_annual) for relative relationship discovery; do not mix directly with PT1
validation_experiment_required: Phase 4 benchmark model training comparing SO-fitted returns to experience vs PLFS wage floors

claim_or_decision: Public job board scrapes (Naukri/AmbitionBox/Glassdoor) are legally disqualified for model training
supporting_source: Info Edge India Ltd. Terms of Use (Sec. 4); Glassdoor Terms; Rule R-DA-01
contradictory_evidence: Datasets exist and are widely circulated on Kaggle with CC0 tags
evidence_quality: Tier A (Binding Terms of Service Audit)
practical_implication: Classify all portal scrapes as Rejected or Test-Fixture-Only; zero ingestion into production feature stores
validation_experiment_required: Pre-commit and CI source-manifest validation enforcing config/sources.yaml approved list

claim_or_decision: Advertised job posting salary ranges cannot be substituted for settled employee guaranteed cash
supporting_source: T1.01 Target Specifications (docs/research/01-targets.md); Labour economics literature
contradictory_evidence: Advertised salaries correlate broadly with industry averages
practical_implication: PT3 (Advertised Range) must remain distinct from PT1 (Settled Cash); advertised ranges reflect hiring budgets and have >60% missingness
validation_experiment_required: Compare advertised salary midpoints with verified voluntary submissions for identical role/YOE cells

claim_or_decision: Sample size (N) alone cannot validate an estimate or justify an evidence grade (D-010 / R-EV-07)
supporting_source: ArthaIQ Methodological Invariant D-010; Rules R-EV-07 & R-UQ-07
contradictory_evidence: Common industry practice relies on large row counts without checking provenance or deduplication
practical_implication: Quality must be evaluated on orthogonal axes: Source Quality Tier (A-D) and Prediction Support Level (Supported/Guarded/Abstained)
validation_experiment_required: Cell sufficiency testing in Phase 2 with effective sample size (N_eff) after deduplication

claim_or_decision: Levels.fyi scraped mirrors on Kaggle carry fatal intellectual property and breach-of-terms liability
supporting_source: Levels.fyi Terms of Service; Jack Ogozaly Kaggle mirror audit
contradictory_evidence: Levels.fyi explicitly unbundles base salary, stock, and bonus matching our desired schema
practical_implication: Reject Levels.fyi mirrors for model training; use schema architecture purely as conceptual reference for unbundling
validation_experiment_required: Audit of ingestion pipeline to guarantee no automated calls or mirror ingestion from Levels.fyi

claim_or_decision: ai-jobs.net open feeds are legally usable but geographically unrepresentative of domestic Indian tech employment
supporting_source: ai-jobs.net open data initiative (CC0); Candidate 09/10 audit
contradictory_evidence: Has 14,000+ clean global rows with verified CC0 license
practical_implication: Approved as Benchmark-Only for remote work premiums and international purchasing power parity; disqualified for Indian domestic cell estimates
validation_experiment_required: Measure N_IN in ai-jobs.net feeds (<600 rows, majority remote US contractors)
